text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bosnian and Slovenian chambers of commerce sign a memorandum on cooperation on Tuesday and pledged to work together in exports and reinforce bilateral business ties.

- Continious pressure to sack some of our personnel with the presence of an international military factor in Bosnia can "slow down" the U.S.-backed "Train and Equip" programme, Bosnian supreme commander General Rasim Delic says in an interview.
- Arguments for sacking Hasan Cengic, Bosnian deputy Minister of Defence have not been sufficient so far, spokesman of the ruling Moslem SDA party, Ismet Grbo, says.
